JThetaAttachment.originalBruhat_theta_log_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K → ℂ)
  (hf : JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f) (U : Set (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) (hU : IsCompact U) (R : ℝ) :
  ∃ B,
    0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ a ∈ U,
        ∀ (u : ℝ),
          0 ≤ u →
            ‖Masullo.IdeleTheta.classTheta K f ↑(JThetaAttachment.thetaLogSection K u * a)‖ ≤ B * Real.exp (-R * u)
